notes: Album-aware track lookup with per-album query and cache keys; page classification and strict attribution reject cross-entity material and citations; summary/knowledge caches migrated to v6 with stale-while-revalidate and per-language knowledge files; /api/entity/knowledge returns pending immediately and deduplicates concurrent jobs; missing-tag tracks fall back to filename parsing, with an insufficient-metadata state and zero network requests for pure track numbers. · 单曲检索纳入专辑上下文并按专辑分 query 与缓存键；新增页面分类与严格归属校验，跨实体材料与引用整份拒收；summary/knowledge 缓存迁移至 v6，旧代际标记过期并后台重算，knowledge 按语言分文件；/api/entity/knowledge 立即返回 pending 且并发任务去重；无标签曲目改用文件名解析，纯曲号明确提示「资料不足」且 0 次网络请求。
